horoscope: A Mars-Chiron square can dominate the first half of the day, dear Aries, pointing to possible tensions due to a lack of connection with what you truly want or a sense that things around you are moving too quickly. Tensions may rise with family if problems have been left to fester. Someone close to you may feel threatened by changes you are making in your personality. You are expressing your more unique qualities, and while this is growth-oriented and positive, it can take others time to adjust. Your interactions can have tense undercurrents. However, as the day advances, enjoying and expressing yourself comes more naturally. As well, Mars, your fiery and courageous ruling planet, begins its transit of your solar fifth house. This transit will come in two parts, the first of which lasts until November 25th. This transit brings extra dynamism, stimulation, and action to your creative, entertainment, and romantic worlds. It can be a time for stepping up your creative life, hobbies, pastimes, or leisure activities. If you channel this energy well, it is a fine time to pursue your heart's desire. Your direct approach tends to get you results. You're in an energized period for relationships.

Past matters or guilt can nag at you and interfere early today, dear Taurus, with a Mars-Chiron square that can pull up some doubts. Still, occasional uncertainty can help if it slows you down and points you to vulnerable areas. You may feel a little more fragile or emotional than usual, especially if past problems resurface. Try to battle the urge to make a quick change. As the day advances, it’s easier to go with the flow. As well, Mars enters your home and family sector, and you'll be pouring more energy into your personal life in the weeks ahead. This transit can stir your desire to do something about difficult conditions or relationships, and also to fix, improve, and otherwise renovate your life from the ground up, especially your domestic world. While you can experience variable energy and motivation levels in the weeks ahead, it's an excellent time for taking care of household and family matters. Watch for bottling up anger, as you may feel protective of others and yourself now, but perhaps a little too defensive. This transit will occur in two parts, the first of which lasts from today until November 25th.

In the first half of the day, money, boundary, or ownership matters can frustrate or stress you a little, dear Gemini. Insecurities tend to be a driving force with a Mars-Chiron aspect in play, and decisions made under these conditions can feel too forced or unnatural. You may be teetering between going forward on a matter full speed ahead and backing up or holding off, and the indecision can be maddening! Actions taken now can be ill-timed, primarily because you are out of touch with what you truly want or need. As well, Mars is moving on, and you're turning a new page. Later today, Mars begins its transit of your communications sector. This transit will happen in two parts, the first of which begins now and lasts until November 25th. You may feel strongly motivated to learn something new in the weeks ahead, or this could be a particularly busy time in your neighborhood or daily life. You can get quite fired up over ideas and opinions. This can also be a time for mustering up the courage to contact someone with whom you've been out of touch. Watch for hasty communications, and instead try to pour your energy into intellectual tasks since you can get a whole lot done now. You're likely to be working with much passion and vigor, whether it's on actual work or your favorite projects.

Your desire to go your own way and to do your own thing has been strong with Mars in your sign, dear Cancer, but Mars is moving on today. Before it goes, it forms a square with Chiron, and there can be a strong pull toward what others expect of you today. It will be important not to act out as a result of this inner tension between your independent feelings and the expectations of others. Anger can bubble up from within quite unexpectedly, and it’s a great idea to examine whether it’s emotional slush you’ve been carrying with you that deserves your attention. Doubting yourself early today can feel so uncomfortable that you might jump into a quick decision, but it's probably best to avoid this. Be gentle with yourself and your activities and projects for the best results now. Mars moves into your resources sector later today, and until November 25th, you can be motivated to build and develop something important to you, such as a business, pet project, bank account, or relationship. With less focus on personality development, you're moving into a great period for enjoying what you have and building upon your resources at a comfortable pace. Your drive to make money or to make your life more secure increases, although you may want to watch for sudden "needs" that may seem frivolous if given some thought and time. Much of your energy will go into business endeavors and seeking material security.

You've been doing a mental type of spring cleaning these days, which can be an empowering process, dear Leo. There's been a part of you dealing with ghosts from the past, past mistakes, and inner insecurities, and this process is necessary so that you can be “all you can be” in the coming weeks. Mars moves into your sign today, but early today, it forms a tense aspect, and people can be touchy. Differences of opinion may be more glaring than usual. Try not to fall for the trap that if someone disagrees with your opinion, they somehow don’t respect or care about you. The day advances more smoothly. Mars will stay in your sign until November 25th, although it will return early in February, and will bring its qualities of fiery assertiveness, courage, initiative, and energy to your personality. This transit can stimulate strong desires to begin new projects or to present yourself in bolder, more dynamic ways. You have more energy during this cycle, sometimes to the point of excess, and it's a good idea to find ways to manage it to your advantage. Pace yourself, but act on what matters most to you.

A Mars-Chiron square influencing the first half of the day is indecisive energy, dear Virgo. It may be best to take a deep breath and avoid getting caught up in drama, even if others pull you into it. Some frustrating elements may be affecting your social interactions. Avoid worrying too much about your place in your friends’ lives, and if someone’s methods bother you, try to dismiss them. It may not be worth the argument or stress. Mars begins its transit of your soul sector today, and will transit here in two parts, the first of which will be until November 25th. Mars brings energy and courage to your inner world and private life, and you might feel especially motivated to deal with problems left outstanding or unresolved in the past, once and for all. Sometimes with this transit, if you don't acknowledge your need for more rest, you'll feel under the weather now. Don't mistake this apparent slowdown for bad luck. In fact, it's a time to recharge your spirit, laying to rest plans that have had their day in the sun or have outgrown their usefulness.

In the first half of the day, there can be some tension as you can feel that others are not entirely getting what you mean, dear Libra, or they misunderstand your goals and intentions. The urge to break away or change your schedule can be intense, but it will likely remain only an urge. Stronger demands on your time may leave you with fewer opportunities to pursue your interests. You’ll want to direct your energy toward areas that require change, updates, and a more progressive approach, but it may take time today to figure out exactly what those are or how to move forward. Give yourself some space and time. It’s easier to let things flow as the day advances. Also today, Mars enters your solar eleventh house, and until November 25th, it is lending extra energy, courage, assertiveness, and fire to this sector of groups, friendships, and aspirations. A more active and lively social life is likely now, or there can be a stronger focus on group or teamwork. You can play a bigger role in others' lives now. Generally speaking, competitive energy with friends is motivating now—something inspires you through your friends or networks to take better charge of your life or work toward a special goal or dream.

With a Mars-Chiron square dominating the first half of the day, dear Scorpio, you can feel subject to others’ unpredictable moods. There is a sense that change is on the horizon, but you may not know what it means or where to direct your energies. The result can be half-hearted attempts that fail to satisfy, but it's temporary. You may struggle to tolerate the dull or routine parts of your life, pushing you to consider areas that should change. Also today, Mars moves to the top of your solar chart, and until November 25th, it transits your career and reputation sector, bringing high energy and ambition, plus motivation and competitive feelings, into your world. This sector of your solar chart governs your life path goals, public life, responsibilities, performance, business affairs, and career, and these matters can awaken, enliven, and take on far more importance in your life than usual.

With a Mars-Chiron square influencing early today, dear Sagittarius, you can waver between wanting to get closer to someone and keeping your distance. The same may be true of a project or venture as part of you wants to go forward, but another is afraid of taking on too much. You may feel rushed or pressured into something. Watch for reading too much into others’ actions today. It can be easy for others to touch a nerve with you, and if this does happen, look more closely at why this may be the case. Avoid overstimulation if possible this morning, and as the day advances, allow your intuition to kick in. Mars moves on today, and it will motivate you to actively learn and participate until November 25th. This transit can boost your spirits and zest for life. This is an enthusiastic and energetic cycle in which you feel more confident about making changes or trying new things. You're attracted to new physical or mental challenges, and your desire to learn about the world and share your ideas and opinions increases. Debates can become very lively and passionate at this time. You may take up a new interest, self-publish, or pursue a course of study. You're seeking out truth and justice as well as greater understanding of the world around you and your place in it. Routines can bore you more than usual, however, and you'll be wise to keep one foot on the ground.

Frustrations can work close to the surface in the first half of the day, dear Capricorn, with a Mars-Chiron square that stirs up touchiness. If you want to clear the air with someone, consider that it may trigger defensiveness if you aren’t entirely sure of yourself. Certain problems can magnify under this transit, and you can be especially sensitive to any feeling of lack of support or concern from people in your life. It would help to identify the source of your vulnerability and allow yourself to feel it so you can understand yourself better. This mission is easier later today. Also today, Mars heads into your solar eighth house. Now and until November 25th, Mars heats up your intimacy sector, encouraging you to seek deeper connections, whether with a project or a person! You're more strategic about going after what and who you want during this cycle. You're also more willing and courageous than usual to dig deep and acknowledge your innermost desires. If you've been having issues with power dynamics and sharing in a relationship, now is the time to pull them out of hiding. It can also be a time for pursuing a loan or support if needed.

With a Mars-Chiron square influencing the first half of the day, dear Aquarius, there can be a feeling of being unsettled or insecure. If you feel overcome with pressure to make changes, try to tame it. Insecurities about a work project or function can magnify under this influence, or uncertainties about your communications or work output may be at play. Someone could touch a nerve and stir up buried emotions. Avoid allowing this feeling to dominate, especially if it means bowing out of an important task. Allow yourself the right to feel vulnerable, if only to get to know yourself better, as the day can have something to teach you about what needs healing. Later today, it becomes easier to live more confidently and positively. Also today, Mars moves into your partnership sector, and its courageous, energetic, and active qualities now apply to partnerships, relationships, and teamwork. This cycle runs until November 25th, and enlivens partnerships. You tend to attract more assertive or outgoing people into your life. You might find others energizing, or irritating, depending on your current disposition! There can be a competitive feel to relationships during this cycle.

With a Mars-Chiron square influencing the first half of the day, dear Pisces, a difference in values can stir tension. It may be better to recognize that your values are changing, and others in your life may have difficulty adjusting. People can be a little touchy, as insecurities can be operating very close to the surface, and for you, this can be about money and whether or not others are treating you with respect. Try to muster up patience and examine any strong reactions you may have, as they can be keys to problem areas that can do with some healing and individual attention. Later today, Mars moves on, heading into your work and health sector for a stay until November 25th. You are ready for action, bringing more energy to your work and/or to your health routines. If you haven't seen real results with health programs, this might be a time to begin anew. Watch, however, for overdoing things. It may be best to ease into things, because while Mars is motivating, it can also be competitive. If you can work independently or set your own pace, do so now, as you can get a lot done. If you can take the lead, this can be beneficial in the weeks ahead.
